\## Rajasthan Helper CLI – Your Challenge-Winning Project

Project Goal: A lightweight Python CLI tool for quick Rajasthan/India info (weather via free wttr.in API, festivals, travel tips). Built on free GitHub Copilot CLI tier for the challenge – showcase efficiency, local theme, low prompt count.



Language: Python 3

CLI Framework: Click

Output: Colorful panels/tables with rich library + emojis

Dependencies: click, rich, requests (keep minimal)

APIs: wttr.in JSON<a href="https://wttr.in/{city}?format=j1" target="\_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"></a>

Code Style: Clean, readable, strong error handling, fun Rajasthan-themed messages (e.g., "Discover the Land of Kings! 🏜️")

Efficiency: Batch big prompts, minimize requests (aim <15 total), document prompt count in README

Challenge Focus: Original local utility, free-tier proof, terminal demo GIF
